llm.summary: This SatisMeter skill is mostly a bounded read-only OOMOL connector, but its setup instructions include unsafe direct execution of remote installer scripts.

dimensions.detail: The skill uses the oo connector and says OOMOL injects credentials server-side, so SatisMeter data and action parameters flow through OOMOL as expected for this integration.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: First-time setup tells users to run curl-to-bash and PowerShell Invoke-Expression installers from cli.oomol.com without checksum, signature, pinning, or review, creating a material supply-chain execution risk.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The activation language is broad for SatisMeter, but it remains bounded to SatisMeter use and includes confirmation guidance for any write or destructive actions, even though none are listed.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill asks for one-time CLI installation, login, and SatisMeter connection only after matching failures; no hidden background worker, persistence hook, or unrelated privilege request is present in the artifact.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is to search and read SatisMeter data through the OOMOL oo CLI, and the listed connector actions are read-only get/list/statistics actions.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Review the setup path before installing. Use a safer verified or package-manager install for the oo CLI where possible, avoid running remote scripts directly into bash or PowerShell, and be aware that SatisMeter requests will be handled through OOMOL's connector service.
llm.findings:
[SC2] unexpected: Installing the oo CLI is purpose-related, but directly piping mutable remote installer content into a shell is not necessary or proportionate for the read-only SatisMeter workflow.
[SQP-1] expected: The broad SatisMeter routing language is overbroad but still service-bounded, and the runtime commands are limited to the SatisMeter connector with listed read actions.
[T03] unexpected: The static remote-execution concern is supported by the artifact's installer commands; this supports Review, not malicious classification, because the behavior is disclosed setup guidance rather than hidden payload execution.
